page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Top: a small line in faint type. Centre: the large title "RESPVBLICA GRAECORVM" in capitals, with a smaller line beneath. Below the title: an engraving of a figure beside a tree, with a caption line under it. Lower block, centred: a line of imprint, a place and printer line, a rule, a date line, and a small line in brackets at the foot. No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: The scan is faint and much of the type shows through from the reverse of the leaf, so the small lines above and below the title are mostly unreadable. The large title words are clear. The engraving has no legible text inside it; its caption under the picture is partly visible but not legible. The imprint lines are too faint to read reliably: the place and printer line and the date line have been left as illegible rather than guessed. The date appears to be a Roman numeral in the old reversed-C form, but it cannot be read with confidence. The line in brackets at the foot is probably a privilege notice, but it is also not legible. No page number, running head or catchword is printed.
